name: netsurf
summary: NetSurf — the gucOS browser (NetSurf 3.12 core + gucOS SDL frontend; file:, data: and http(s): over the kernel HTTP transport)

res/mime.types.content:
# Extension -> MIME type map for file:// browsing, consulted by
# /bin/netsurf (the monkey filetype resolver; /etc/mime.types, if
# present, is preferred over this file). Standard mime.types lines:
# TYPE<ws>EXT [EXT...].
text/html	html htm
text/css	css
text/javascript	js mjs
text/plain	txt text conf log md
image/png	png
image/jpeg	jpg jpeg
image/gif	gif
image/bmp	bmp
image/ico	ico
